contract.authority_note: ⚠️ THE LAYER IS `parameter`, NOT `oracle`, AND THE RELABEL IS THE FINDING (security_analyst, 2026-09-06). `oracle` means the price FEED; `parameter` means who can change WHICH FEED a market reads. setMaxLTV, setLiquidationThreshold and setCollatOracle are all parameter setters. Filing them as `oracle` invited a reader to ask whether the price source is sound, when the question is whether the POINTER to it can be swapped — and a sound oracle behind a swappable pointer is not a sound price. No score moved on the relabel; what a reader takes away did.
